source: Quiz 4 - Sessions 1-5: Building and Improving Agent Skills
question: In a lecture-notes workflow, what role do the newly created notes play?

options.text: The procedure that replaces future instructions
options.feedback: One finished set of notes contains a particular lecture's content. It does not replace instructions for processing other lectures.

options.text: The metadata used to discover every skill
options.feedback: Discovery uses short skill descriptions. Newly created notes are the product of an already selected workflow.

options.text: The source transcript supplied before the run
options.feedback: The transcript is an input. The newly written notes are what the procedure produces from that input.
The notes are the result of applying a reusable procedure to the current lecture material.
